title: Interfaces infraweave leaves out as superseded, and deprecated ones it serves
description: A superseded record (SUP-) is an interface decision 0021's supersession test leaves out: S1 retired, S2 schema-deprecated with a replacement infraweave serves, S2a a shadowed V1 twin, S3 deprecated with a named replacement by the source that owns an interface the schema does not hold. No phase builds it; replacementPhase names the phase that serves the need instead. Report 26 section 7 holds the evidence. A served record (DEP-) stays served and carries deprecated: true, because the schema or a decision keeps it live.

kind.description: What sort of interface it is: an operation, a field, an enum value, a provider resource.

rule.description: The supersession rule of decision 0021 that holds, and how.

replacementPhase.description: The phases that serve the replacement, or none.

operations.description: The reference operations the record leaves out, each as <product>:<operationId>, such as deploy:stackCreate. specref parity reports them superseded and fails when one is served; docscheck fails when one is not an operation of that product's reference.

enumValues.description: The values of Deploy's GraphQL enums the record leaves out, each as <Type>.<VALUE>, such as PolicyType.ACCESS. TestUnitSupersededEnums fails when a served enum lists one; docscheck fails when one is not a value of that enum in the schema snapshot.

phase.description: The phase that serves the deprecated interface.
